# Third-party libraries

The firmware uses these Arduino libraries. They're copied here unchanged so the simulator builds
without network access.

| Directory | Library | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PID/` | Arduino PID Library 1.2.1, Brett Beauregard | https://github.com/br3ttb/Arduino-PID-Library (`524a4268fc01e6ea397e7fc5b5d820741e9b662f`) | MIT (see the header of `PID_v1.cpp`) |
| `PID_AutoTune/` | Arduino PID AutoTune Library 0.0.1, Brett Beauregard, from William Spinelli's AutotunerPID Toolkit | https://github.com/br3ttb/Arduino-PID-AutoTune-Library (`7c03cf3e7cd4986e63e7e5ce9a8ff2bc222f8578`) | BSD (see `PID_AutoTune/LICENSE.txt`) |
